_comment: Single source of truth for which gateways the compat suite runs against.
Read by the `compat` matrix in ci.yml, by the compat sweep and by
deploy/ci/e2e-stack.sh, and edited by the sweep's automated bump PR.
Every lane here is REQUIRED on every PR, so together the lanes are the
range this dashboard claims to support: the oldest release it still works
with and the newest release it has been tested against. Looking further
ahead — at newer releases and upstream HEAD — is the scheduled sweep's job.
Lanes are RELEASES pinned by digest (tag@digest: the tag is for readers,
the digest is what gets pulled). Do not pin a `dev` build here: a dev
gateway resolves ghcr.io/nvidia/openshell/sandbox:dev at runtime, so a
digest-pinned dev lane still drifts with upstream HEAD and broke main on
2026-10-02. A release resolves sandbox:<its own version> instead.
floor / floor_release: the newest release in the lanes. Both names are
historical — the sweep looks for releases NEWER than floor_release.
sdk: the pin in backend/go.mod, recorded for the sweep's report.
sandbox_image: the workload image compat sandboxes run. It publishes no
version tags, so it is pinned by digest and held constant across lanes.
